vehicle: tb_qwen_me_partition_w12: GT 16, TG 4 (4 tiles + tree nodes), XTX 2, production pipeline parameters, 300 random ops, event-exact against the mono matvec reference
note: NDH needs W 16 (the fixed hardened leaf ot_qwen_tile_node), so the full r5 hierarchy (RPH 1 + NDH 1) is benched at W 16; the W 4 series is the existing job-spec vehicle with RPH 1 only. RPH 1 = soft ot_qwen_rpair_logic per bank row, NDH 1 = the ot_qwen_tile_node RTL: the logic the hardened leaves contain. TMUT 3 is caught by the bench request-copy check, TMUT 5 by a raised fault, BMUT 2 by result write event 0. RPH 2 (black-box leaf + views) is lint-elaborated only: it has no simulation model apart from RPH 1.
